author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

This PR started as a follow up to a few deficiencies in testing that came up in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/45216. Following improvements are made
* Handling of `inf` and `nan` when generating the `cfi` files (in case anyone would use them as default values)
* Add checks for the max, `inf`, and `nan` for double and float to `ProducerWithPSetDesc`
* Extend `edmProvDump` tests to cover all parameter types with `ProducerWithPSetDesc`
  * The `V{Event,LuminosoityBlock}ID` and `V{Event,LuminosoityBlock}Range` printouts contained null characters, so the `operator<<()` of `edm::Entry` is improved to avoid those
  * `edmRNTupleTempProvDump` did not have any tests, so the `edmProvDump` tests are copied and converted to use the `RNTupleTemp` modules

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2345

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass
title: Extend testing of corner cases of floating point parameter
